interpretation.improvement_fraction: (initial error - frozen error)/(initial error - full error); relative-L2 reduction, not squared loss
interpretation.invalid_ratios: Undefined if full error increased or full improvement <= 1e-12*max(1,errors)
interpretation.slow_floor: Maximum of six prelisted frozen-GD spectral lower bounds; FP64 audit, not interval certification
interpretation.causality: Freezes a,b exactly at the shared post-repair state; readout GD uses the same eta and budget
